usedFor: Cliengo holds new customers and contacts, and HubSpot holds the pipeline where “Create Deal” opens a deal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer/Contact” in Cliengo, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new contact is the earliest sign of a sale, and the action opens the deal for your team.

watchOut: “Updated Customer” in Cliengo fires on updates too, so use “Create or Update Contact” to avoid duplicates.
